2608.12062.title: Preference Tree Optimization: Enhancing Goal-Oriented Dialogue with Look-Ahead Simulations
2608.12062.paper_summary: Developing dialogue systems capable of engaging in multi-turn, goal-oriented conversations remains a significant challenge, especially in specialized domains with limited data. This research proposes a novel framework called Preference Tree Optimization (PTO), designed to iteratively improve agent models in such dialogue systems, by generating preference data using a method called Preference Tree with Look-Ahead. Focusing on Motivational Interviewing (MI) -- a counseling technique aimed at facilitating behavioral change -- we leverage virtual patients and an oracle evaluator to simulate conversations and generate rich preference datasets. By combining this method with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), we aim to enhance the agent's decision-making capabilities over iterative training cycles. The proposed framework addresses data scarcity and advances the development of more nuanced and effective dialogue systems in goal-oriented domains. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the PTO framework enhances dialogue agents' performance in goal-oriented conversations within the domain of Motivational Interviewing (MI). Models trained with PTO consistently outperformed the baseline in key metrics such as session satisfaction and working alliance. Additionally, incorporating look-ahead simulations led to improved long-term planning and more effective conversational strategies, with deeper look-ahead configurations yielding the most stable and high-scoring results.
2608.12062.paper_summary_zh: 開發能夠進行多輪、以目標為導向的對話系統仍然是一項重大挑戰，尤其是在數據有限的專業領域中。這項研究提出了一個名為偏好樹優化（Preference Tree Optimization, PTO）的新框架，旨在通過使用一種稱為帶前瞻的偏好樹（Preference Tree with Look-Ahead）的方法來迭代改進此類對話系統中的代理模型，生成偏好數據。專注於動機性訪談（Motivational Interviewing, MI）——一種旨在促進行為改變的諮詢技術——我們利用虛擬病人和一個神諭評估者來模擬對話並生成豐富的偏好數據集。通過將這種方法與直接偏好優化（Direct Preference Optimization, DPO）結合，我們旨在增強代理在迭代訓練周期中的決策能力。所提出的框架解決了數據稀缺問題，並推進了在以目標為導向的領域中開發更細緻和有效的對話系統。實驗評估表明，PTO框架提高了對話代理在動機性訪談（MI）領域中的目標導向對話表現。使用PTO訓練的模型在關鍵指標如會話滿意度和工作聯盟方面始終超越基準。此外，納入前瞻模擬導致了改進的長期規劃和更有效的對話策略，深度前瞻配置產生了最穩定和高分的結果。
